findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 1440px: "Soy Ingeniero del Software, he pasado po…" → 5 lines at 36px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.
Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.1:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 1 real photograph(s) or clip(s); the rest are interface fragments.
findings.fix: Add two or more real pictures of the customer's world from scripts/assets.mjs, not stock of people at laptops.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Zodiak and Hanken Grotesk, but the page renders General Sans, monospace.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 689px of the width empty: "Contacto".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("Francisco Ramírez") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 3 screens in a row: "ClipSync"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.
